requirements.summary: Promote Draft Version 10 to the live/production deployment with no application code or asset changes.
acceptanceCriteria: The live/production deployment points to Draft Version 10.
No frontend or backend source files are changed as part of this request.
After publishing, opening the public live link shows the Version 10 build (matching the Draft Version 10 preview).

file_operations.description: Add an English-only deployment checklist describing the non-code steps to promote Draft Version 10 to live/production (deployment-only verification steps and post-publish validation), without changing any application source code or assets.
